Help-center excerpts:

[card-metal] The Premium metal card (effective 2025-01-01)
Premium members get a metal debit card. It works exactly like the plastic card, with the same number, limits and controls.

## Getting your metal card

When you upgrade to Premium, the app asks whether you want a metal card now or at your next renewal. If you order it now, your current card keeps working until you activate the metal one.

## Replacing it

Replacements for a lost, stolen or damaged metal card are metal and free on Premium. Expedited shipping is free on Premium too, and takes 2 to 3 business days.

## If you leave Premium

Your

[card-metal] The Premium metal card (effective 2025-01-01)
takes 2 to 3 business days.

## If you leave Premium

Your metal card keeps working until it expires. After that, or if you need a replacement, you'll get a plastic card.

## Disposal

Metal cards can't be cut with scissors. When you replace one, you can mail it back to us in the prepaid envelope that comes with the new card, and we'll recycle it.

Contactless works on metal cards the same way it does on plastic.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[plan-premium] The Premium plan (effective 2026-06-01)
**Expedited card shipping:** free
- **Savings Pockets:** 3.75% APY
- **Cushion:** fee-free coverage up to $200 on debit card purchases
- **Daily card spending limit:** $10,000
- **Daily ATM limit:** $1,500

## Good to know

Premium members can get an emergency replacement card delivered abroad within 3 business days at no cost. Your card is metal, and replacements are metal too.

You can change plans any time in the app under Profile, then Plan. Upgrades start right away.

[plan-plus] The Plus plan (effective 2026-06-01)
**Card replacement:** free
- **Expedited card shipping:** $25.00
- **Savings Pockets:** 2.00% APY
- **Cushion:** fee-free coverage up to $50.00 on debit card purchases
- **Daily card spending limit:** $5,000
- **Daily ATM limit:** $1,000

## Good to know

Plus includes outgoing international wires for $35.00 each. Your card is plastic, like Basic. Upgrade to Premium if you want the metal card.

You can change plans any time in the app

[plan-premium] The Premium plan (effective 2026-06-01)
Premium costs $15.00 a month. It removes nearly every fee we charge, comes with a metal card, and has the highest limits and savings rate we offer.

## What's included

- **Monthly fee:** $15.00
- **ATMs:** no Tallowbrook fee at any ATM in the US, and we reimburse ATM owner surcharges up to $10.00 a month.
- **Foreign transaction fee:** 0% of the purchase amount
- **Card replacement:** free

[card-replacement-premium] Card replacement fees on Premium (effective 2025-01-01)
This is what a replacement card costs on the Premium plan, whether it's lost, stolen or damaged.

| | Cost |
|---|---|
| Replacement card | free |
| Standard shipping (7 to 10 business days) | free |
| Expedited shipping (2 to 3 business days) | free |

On Premium both the card and expedited shipping are free.

Your replacement is a metal card.

## When we don't charge

There's no fee when a card is lost in the mail, when we replace a card because of a problem on our side, or for

[plan-plus] The Plus plan (effective 2026-06-01)
if you want the metal card.

You can change plans any time in the app under Profile, then Plan. Upgrades start right away. Downgrades start on your next billing date.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[card-replacement-premium] Card replacement fees on Premium (effective 2025-01-01)
when we replace a card because of a problem on our side, or for your automatic renewal card.

## How to order

Tap Cards, choose the card, then Replace card. Pick lost, stolen or damaged, and choose a shipping speed. Fees are charged to your main balance when you place the order.

Support can also order a replacement for you in the app chat. The same fees apply either way.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

Can I pick a custom design for my Premium metal card?
